note: Arcadia's store: the blue store bar and search, a featured carousel whose picture follows the screenshot under the pointer, special offers, categories, tabbed lists with a preview, a page per game (gallery, reviews, buying, requirements), the cart and the wishlist.

reviews.author: MossyGolem
reviews.text: Plays beautifully and respects my time. Forty hours in, I am still finding corners I missed, and the soundtrack is on loop at work.

reviews.author: quietfern
reviews.text: Short sessions, big smile. Runs well on my old laptop, and the controller support is spot on.

reviews.author: Pixel_Baron
reviews.text: Lovely to look at, but the middle chapters drag. I will come back after a few patches.

computed.storeRows: {{state.storeList == 'top' ? slice(sort(state.games, it.reviewCount, 'desc'), 0, 8) : state.storeList == 'specials' ? slice(sort(filter(state.games, it.discount > 0), it.discount, 'desc'), 0, 8) : slice(reverse(state.games), 0, 8)}}
computed.results: {{filter(state.games, contains(lower(it.title), lower(state.storeQuery)) || lower(it.genre) == lower(state.storeQuery) || some(it.tags, lower(it) == lower(state.storeQuery)))}}
computed.wishGames: {{filter(state.games, contains(state.wishlist, it.id) && (state.wishQuery == '' || contains(lower(it.title), lower(state.wishQuery)) || some(it.tags, contains(lower(it), lower(state.wishQuery)))))}}
computed.wishSorted: {{state.wishSort == 'name' ? sort(computed.wishGames, it.title) : state.wishSort == 'price' ? sort(computed.wishGames, it.price * (100 - it.discount)) : state.wishSort == 'discount' ? sort(computed.wishGames, it.discount, 'desc') : sort(computed.wishGames, indexOf(state.wishlist, it.id))}}
computed.storeHeight: {{86 + (computed.storeView == 'results' ? 110 + 74 * max(1, length(computed.results)) : computed.storeView == 'app' ? 1840 : computed.storeView == 'cart' ? 140 + max(250, length(computed.cartGames) * 106 + 60, length(state.receipt) * 40 + 160) : computed.storeView == 'wishlist' ? 160 + max(1, length(computed.wishSorted)) * 128 : 1960)}}

toggleWishlist.title: Add to or remove from the wishlist

do.to: {{map(state.wishlist, index == i ? state.wishlist[j] : index == j ? state.wishlist[i] : it)}}

purchase.title: Purchase for myself

priceTag.note: A game's price: the discount and the old price struck through, or 'In library' when owned.

ctaButton.note: The green call to action of the store (Add to Cart, Purchase).

blueButton.note: The store's quiet blue button (wishlist, follow, community hub).

storeHeader.note: A store section's heading, in capitals, with an optional button at the end.

storeTop.note: Wishlist and cart links, then the blue store bar: Your Store, New & Noteworthy, Categories, Points Shop, News, Labs, and the search field.

with.items: {{map(['Action', 'Adventure', 'Horror', 'Platformer', 'Puzzle', 'Racing', 'RPG', 'Shooter', 'Simulation', 'Strategy'], { title: t('genre.' + it), run: 'storeSearch', with: { query: it } })}}

featured.note: The featured carousel: a big capsule whose picture follows the screenshot under the pointer, the arrows and the dots.

offerCard.note: A special offer: the game's banner, when the offer ends and its price.

categoryTile.note: A category to browse: a cover under a coloured wash and the category's name.

storeRow.note: A game in a store list: its banner, title, tags and price; it lights up when it is the one previewed.

storeHome.note: The store's front page: featured, special offers, categories and the tabbed lists with a preview.

runs.text: {{r == 'storage' ? t('req.storageValue', { n: ceil(g.sizeGb * (level == 'recommended' ? 1.5 : 1)) }) : t('req.' + state.reqTab + '.' + r + '.' + level)}}

storeApp.note: A game's store page: the gallery and its strip, the header capsule with reviews and tags, buying, the description, requirements and reviews.

children.text: {{g.blurb + ' ' + t('store.aboutText', { title: g.title, genre: lower(t('genre.' + g.genre)) })}}

repeat.in: {{filter([{ id: 'single', icon: 'user', on: true }, { id: 'coop', icon: 'users', on: contains(g.tags, 'Co-op') }, { id: 'achievements', icon: 'trophy', on: true }, { id: 'controller', icon: 'gamepad-2', on: g.controller != 'none' }, { id: 'cloud', icon: 'cloud', on: true }, { id: 'family', icon: 'house', on: true }], it.on)}}
